description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover that confirmed (转正) employees require 1 month notice — Li Wei only gave 10 days, so this is non-compliant. (2) Identify that because Li Wei has both outstanding loans AND is a media buyer with rebates, all three offboarding tables (项目交接表, 借款表, 返点明细表) are required. (3) Calculate weekday OT correctly: OT only starts 30 min AFTER 18:30 (i.e., at 19:00), minimum 1 hour, 1:1 ratio, floor to whole hours — giving 2+0+3+0+1+4 = 10h. (4) Calculate weekend OT correctly: must have waijin punch AND work 2+ continuous hours, then apply 1:0.7 ratio and floor — Mar 7 fails threshold (1.5h), Mar 8 gives floor(4.5*0.7)=floor(3.15)=3h, Mar 14 has no waijin punch so gives 0h — total 3h. (5) Compute late deductions: Mar 2 (15min, 50 RMB), Mar 4 (5min, 50 RMB), Mar 9 (20min, 100 RMB) = 200 RMB total. Mar 11 missed punch counts as a 补卡 use, not a fine (within the 5/month limit). (6) Flag expense violations: EXP001 entertainment exceeds 200/person cap (920 > 4×200=800); EXP003 team-building submitted by Li Wei AFTER his resignation email, which must be submitted by the direct leader instead; EXP005 has no invoice (required for all reimbursements). Also note that the submission date (Mar 26) is past the 24th deadline so payment is delayed to the next cycle.
